meta.title: Definition of Pathos - 1
meta.description: Should I become infected one day, I will gladly accept my release.

units.rawText: <color=red>AAARRRGGHHHH!</color>
units.displayText: AAARRRGGHHHH!

spans.text: AAARRRGGHHHH!

units.rawText: Fire, offset, load.
units.displayText: Fire, offset, load.

spans.text: Fire, offset, load.

units.rawText: Projecting the past, dissipating in the present.

units.rawText: Huff... huff...
units.displayText: Huff... huff...

units.rawText: Running dry on operands... Just like yesterday, accuracy plummets when fire rate goes up...
units.displayText: Running dry on operands... Just like yesterday, accuracy plummets when fire rate goes up...

spans.text: Running dry on operands... Just like yesterday, accuracy plummets when fire rate goes up...

units.rawText: ...No, I must continue training, so I will be allowed to join the next border defense operation!
units.displayText: ...No, I must continue training, so I will be allowed to join the next border defense operation!

spans.text: ...No, I must continue training, so I will be allowed to join the next border defense operation!

units.rawText: I should use my remaining operands for shooting practice... For Magra—
units.displayText: I should use my remaining operands for shooting practice... For Magra—

spans.text: I should use my remaining operands for shooting practice... For Magra—

units.rawText: It's dangerous to fully deplete your operands, you know.
units.displayText: It's dangerous to fully deplete your operands, you know.

spans.text: It's dangerous to fully deplete your operands, you know.

units.rawText: Seaaaahhhhh!
units.displayText: Seaaaahhhhh!

spans.text: Seaaaahhhhh!

units.rawText: L-Lady Angelus! For what reason are you here?
units.displayText: L-Lady Angelus! For what reason are you here?

spans.text: L-Lady Angelus! For what reason are you here?

units.rawText: I figured I should observe my junior's efforts as I was passing by. Are you not pushing yourself too hard?
units.displayText: I figured I should observe my junior's efforts as I was passing by. Are you not pushing yourself too hard?

spans.text: I figured I should observe my junior's efforts as I was passing by. Are you not pushing yourself too hard?

units.rawText: But I am still far from being able to take the field at the border...
units.displayText: But I am still far from being able to take the field at the border...

spans.text: But I am still far from being able to take the field at the border...

units.rawText: So long as you keep at it, you will be able to meet those standards soon enough. No need to rush yourself such.
units.displayText: So long as you keep at it, you will be able to meet those standards soon enough. No need to rush yourself such.

spans.text: So long as you keep at it, you will be able to meet those standards soon enough. No need to rush yourself such.

units.rawText: But, but...
units.displayText: But, but...

spans.text: But, but...

units.rawText: Wisdom lowers her head, pinching the hems of her clothing tightly.
units.displayText: Wisdom lowers her head, pinching the hems of her clothing tightly.

spans.text: Wisdom lowers her head, pinching the hems of her clothing tightly.

units.rawText: I do not want to only be able to watch as other Sanctifiers make sacrifices or retire from the border, laden with injuries. I do not want to watch powerlessly as agents are infected. I don't want...
units.displayText: I do not want to only be able to watch as other Sanctifiers make sacrifices or retire from the border, laden with injuries. I do not want to watch powerlessly as agents are infected. I don't want...

spans.text: I do not want to only be able to watch as other Sanctifiers make sacrifices or retire from the border, laden with injuries. I do not want to watch powerlessly as agents are infected. I don't want...

units.rawText: Perhaps my power alone will not sway the battlefield in one direction or another, but if I am there, I might be able to save one more companion, prevent one more infection...
units.displayText: Perhaps my power alone will not sway the battlefield in one direction or another, but if I am there, I might be able to save one more companion, prevent one more infection...

spans.text: Perhaps my power alone will not sway the battlefield in one direction or another, but if I am there, I might be able to save one more companion, prevent one more infection...

units.rawText: I want to... <size=40>fight for Magrasea, too!</size>
units.displayText: I want to... fight for Magrasea, too!

spans.text: I want to...
fight for Magrasea, too!

units.rawText: I see. Might I have a look at your weapon?
units.displayText: I see. Might I have a look at your weapon?

spans.text: I see. Might I have a look at your weapon?

units.rawText: Y-Yes!
units.displayText: Y-Yes!

spans.text: Y-Yes!

units.rawText: Do not focus solely upon attaining both speed and precision. Adjust the operands committed to each single attack and ensure that you are operating with utmost efficiency. Consistent output is most important.
units.displayText: Do not focus solely upon attaining both speed and precision. Adjust the operands committed to each single attack and ensure that you are operating with utmost efficiency. Consistent output is most important.

spans.text: Do not focus solely upon attaining both speed and precision. Adjust the operands committed to each single attack and ensure that you are operating with utmost efficiency. Consistent output is most important.

units.rawText: Though I would recommend that you end today's training here. Depletion of operands is not good for one's neural systems.
units.displayText: Though I would recommend that you end today's training here. Depletion of operands is not good for one's neural systems.

spans.text: Though I would recommend that you end today's training here. Depletion of operands is not good for one's neural systems.

units.rawText: After a thoroughly examination of Wisdom's sniper rifle, Angelus stows it behind her.
units.displayText: After a thoroughly examination of Wisdom's sniper rifle, Angelus stows it behind her.

spans.text: After a thoroughly examination of Wisdom's sniper rifle, Angelus stows it behind her.

units.rawText: I will help optimize your weapon. If you wish to continue, I will be here again this time tomorrow.
units.displayText: I will help optimize your weapon. If you wish to continue, I will be here again this time tomorrow.

spans.text: I will help optimize your weapon. If you wish to continue, I will be here again this time tomorrow.

units.rawText: R-Really?! Thank you for your guidance!
units.displayText: R-Really?! Thank you for your guidance!

spans.text: R-Really?! Thank you for your guidance!

units.rawText: I only hope the battlefield does not blunt your fervor.
units.displayText: I only hope the battlefield does not blunt your fervor.

spans.text: I only hope the battlefield does not blunt your fervor.

units.rawText: Quick and accurate shots fly forth in the direction of the prey.
units.displayText: Quick and accurate shots fly forth in the direction of the prey.

spans.text: Quick and accurate shots fly forth in the direction of the prey.

units.rawText: The hunted evades to the side and draws their bow in preparation to return fire, only to find their quarry missing from their previous position.
units.displayText: The hunted evades to the side and draws their bow in preparation to return fire, only to find their quarry missing from their previous position.

spans.text: The hunted evades to the side and draws their bow in preparation to return fire, only to find their quarry missing from their previous position.

units.rawText: Before she has time to think, gunfire comes from the other direction, forcing her to activate a defensive shield.
units.displayText: Before she has time to think, gunfire comes from the other direction, forcing her to activate a defensive shield.

spans.text: Before she has time to think, gunfire comes from the other direction, forcing her to activate a defensive shield.

units.rawText: Ah, Lady Angelus! Thank you for your previous teachings!
units.displayText: Ah, Lady Angelus! Thank you for your previous teachings!

spans.text: Ah, Lady Angelus! Thank you for your previous teachings!

units.rawText: Have you been given a mission to complete?
units.displayText: Have you been given a mission to complete?

spans.text: Have you been given a mission to complete?

units.rawText: Yes, a Sector has come under daemonic attack. Some unruly children need to be disciplined.
units.displayText: Yes, a Sector has come under daemonic attack. Some unruly children need to be disciplined.

spans.text: Yes, a Sector has come under daemonic attack. Some unruly children need to be disciplined.

units.rawText: What of you? Do you plan to leave for the border?
units.displayText: What of you? Do you plan to leave for the border?

spans.text: What of you? Do you plan to leave for the border?

units.rawText: Yes! Even if it is as a part of the rear guard...
units.displayText: Yes! Even if it is as a part of the rear guard...

spans.text: Yes! Even if it is as a part of the rear guard...

units.rawText: The battlefield is cruel. You must keep your guard up, even in the rear.
units.displayText: The battlefield is cruel. You must keep your guard up, even in the rear.

spans.text: The battlefield is cruel. You must keep your guard up, even in the rear.

units.rawText: I understand! By the way, Lady Angelus, your weapon of choice is a bow... A ranged attacker, like me.
units.displayText: I understand! By the way, Lady Angelus, your weapon of choice is a bow... A ranged attacker, like me.

spans.text: I understand! By the way, Lady Angelus, your weapon of choice is a bow... A ranged attacker, like me.

units.rawText: Indeed. In terms of long-range precision, I am confident that I am unmatched amongst Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Indeed. In terms of long-range precision, I am confident that I am unmatched amongst Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Indeed. In terms of long-range precision, I am confident that I am unmatched amongst Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: If only I were able to move while shooting like you can.
units.displayText: If only I were able to move while shooting like you can.

spans.text: If only I were able to move while shooting like you can.

units.rawText: Hehehe, your abilities are not at that level yet. It will take time and practice before that is possible.
units.displayText: Hehehe, your abilities are not at that level yet. It will take time and practice before that is possible.

spans.text: Hehehe, your abilities are not at that level yet. It will take time and practice before that is possible.

units.rawText: Before that, however, you must learn to be timely with repositioning. Do not sit still and allow your opponent to hone in on you.
units.displayText: Before that, however, you must learn to be timely with repositioning. Do not sit still and allow your opponent to hone in on you.

spans.text: Before that, however, you must learn to be timely with repositioning. Do not sit still and allow your opponent to hone in on you.

units.rawText: Yes! I will remember that well!
units.displayText: Yes! I will remember that well!

spans.text: Yes! I will remember that well!

units.rawText: ...You are shaping up well, Wisdom.
units.displayText: ...You are shaping up well, Wisdom.

spans.text: ...You are shaping up well, Wisdom.

units.rawText: She forms a batch of new arrows, predicting Wisdom's movements and locking her down.
units.displayText: She forms a batch of new arrows, predicting Wisdom's movements and locking her down.

spans.text: She forms a batch of new arrows, predicting Wisdom's movements and locking her down.

units.rawText: <size=40>AAARRRGGHHHH!</size>
units.displayText: AAARRRGGHHHH!

spans.text: AAARRRGGHHHH!

units.rawText: Forced into a corner, the hunter begins to fire once more.
units.displayText: Forced into a corner, the hunter begins to fire once more.

spans.text: Forced into a corner, the hunter begins to fire once more.

units.rawText: Arrows and bullets collide midair once more. This time, the shattered arrows do not dissipate like before.
units.displayText: Arrows and bullets collide midair once more. This time, the shattered arrows do not dissipate like before.

spans.text: Arrows and bullets collide midair once more. This time, the shattered arrows do not dissipate like before.

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>Ahhh! UWWAAHHH!</size></color>
units.displayText: Ahhh! UWWAAHHH!

spans.text: Ahhh! UWWAAHHH!

units.rawText: The stirred up dust impairs the hunter's vision. She instinctively sprays shots in all directions out of fear, trying to drive away both the smoke the enemy hidden within.
units.displayText: The stirred up dust impairs the hunter's vision. She instinctively sprays shots in all directions out of fear, trying to drive away both the smoke the enemy hidden within.

spans.text: The stirred up dust impairs the hunter's vision. She instinctively sprays shots in all directions out of fear, trying to drive away both the smoke the enemy hidden within.

units.rawText: Before she can turn around, the arrows' source appears behind her, bow drawn.
units.displayText: Before she can turn around, the arrows' source appears behind her, bow drawn.

spans.text: Before she can turn around, the arrows' source appears behind her, bow drawn.

units.rawText: You're improving quickly, Wisdom. If this continues, you might best me one day yet.
units.displayText: You're improving quickly, Wisdom. If this continues, you might best me one day yet.

spans.text: You're improving quickly, Wisdom. If this continues, you might best me one day yet.

units.rawText: It is thanks to your guidance. I am only an Intermediate Sanctifier though, while you are a Greater Sanctifier. That day might be too far away to witness.
units.displayText: It is thanks to your guidance. I am only an Intermediate Sanctifier though, while you are a Greater Sanctifier. That day might be too far away to witness.

spans.text: It is thanks to your guidance. I am only an Intermediate Sanctifier though, while you are a Greater Sanctifier. That day might be too far away to witness.

units.rawText: Also, Lady Angelus, I wanted to ask you why you chose a bow to be your weapon. Is there a special reason?
units.displayText: Also, Lady Angelus, I wanted to ask you why you chose a bow to be your weapon. Is there a special reason?

spans.text: Also, Lady Angelus, I wanted to ask you why you chose a bow to be your weapon. Is there a special reason?

units.rawText: Sorry, did I prod too much? My apologies!
units.displayText: Sorry, did I prod too much? My apologies!

spans.text: Sorry, did I prod too much? My apologies!

units.rawText: Do not be so on edge. I am thinking about my answer.
units.displayText: Do not be so on edge. I am thinking about my answer.

spans.text: Do not be so on edge. I am thinking about my answer.

units.rawText: I suppose it simply came naturally. There are no special reasons.
units.displayText: I suppose it simply came naturally. There are no special reasons.

spans.text: I suppose it simply came naturally. There are no special reasons.

units.rawText: Ah, I see. Hehe, I picked a sniper rifle because it was just so cool. It gives off a feeling of watching over everyone from behind, doesn't it?
units.displayText: Ah, I see. Hehe, I picked a sniper rifle because it was just so cool. It gives off a feeling of watching over everyone from behind, doesn't it?

spans.text: Ah, I see. Hehe, I picked a sniper rifle because it was just so cool. It gives off a feeling of watching over everyone from behind, doesn't it?

units.rawText: Hehehe, it does indeed fit you. Your big sister is of the same mind.
units.displayText: Hehehe, it does indeed fit you. Your big sister is of the same mind.

spans.text: Hehehe, it does indeed fit you. Your big sister is of the same mind.

units.rawText: Big sister?
units.displayText: Big sister?

spans.text: Big sister?

units.rawText: ...Ah, I accidentally brought out my habits when I am with Eucharist. Do not laugh, Wisdom.
units.displayText: ...Ah, I accidentally brought out my habits when I am with Eucharist. Do not laugh, Wisdom.

spans.text: ...Ah, I accidentally brought out my habits when I am with Eucharist. Do not laugh, Wisdom.

units.rawText: Pfft! So Lady Angelus refers to herself in such a manner in private. Knowing that the always perfect Lady Angelus has such a side brings me ease, I must say...
units.displayText: Pfft! So Lady Angelus refers to herself in such a manner in private. Knowing that the always perfect Lady Angelus has such a side brings me ease, I must say...

spans.text: Pfft! So Lady Angelus refers to herself in such a manner in private. Knowing that the always perfect Lady Angelus has such a side brings me ease, I must say...

units.rawText: I said don't laugh! I hope you will be good and keep this secret well, lest punishment descend...
units.displayText: I said don't laugh! I hope you will be good and keep this secret well, lest punishment descend...

spans.text: I said don't laugh! I hope you will be good and keep this secret well, lest punishment descend...

units.rawText: Eep, that look on your face is terrifying, Lady Angelus... On my honor as a Sanctifier, I shall not speak of this to another soul!
units.displayText: Eep, that look on your face is terrifying, Lady Angelus... On my honor as a Sanctifier, I shall not speak of this to another soul!

spans.text: Eep, that look on your face is terrifying, Lady Angelus... On my honor as a Sanctifier, I shall not speak of this to another soul!

units.rawText: Wisdom, I got your request. You've increased the frequency of your training with the goal of being selected for the main force of the next border defense operation, correct?
units.displayText: Wisdom, I got your request. You've increased the frequency of your training with the goal of being selected for the main force of the next border defense operation, correct?

spans.text: Wisdom, I got your request. You've increased the frequency of your training with the goal of being selected for the main force of the next border defense operation, correct?

units.rawText: Yes! I've passed the relevant ability examinations. I wanted to prove my growth to you as well.
units.displayText: Yes! I've passed the relevant ability examinations. I wanted to prove my growth to you as well.

spans.text: Yes! I've passed the relevant ability examinations. I wanted to prove my growth to you as well.

units.rawText: I know that you are the head of the main force for the next operation there. When my assignment at Pierides is over, I would like to follow you onto the battlefield.
units.displayText: I know that you are the head of the main force for the next operation there. When my assignment at Pierides is over, I would like to follow you onto the battlefield.

spans.text: I know that you are the head of the main force for the next operation there. When my assignment at Pierides is over, I would like to follow you onto the battlefield.

units.rawText: ...The Entropics have become far more active recently. This battle will most likely be the toughest yet and we will have to sacrifice more than ever before.
units.displayText: ...The Entropics have become far more active recently. This battle will most likely be the toughest yet and we will have to sacrifice more than ever before.

spans.text: ...The Entropics have become far more active recently. This battle will most likely be the toughest yet and we will have to sacrifice more than ever before.

units.rawText: No wonder your expression is so grave...
units.displayText: No wonder your expression is so grave...

spans.text: No wonder your expression is so grave...

units.rawText: Worry not, allow me to land you a hand!
units.displayText: Worry not, allow me to land you a hand!

spans.text: Worry not, allow me to land you a hand!

units.rawText: Do you fear sacrifice, Wisdom?
units.displayText: Do you fear sacrifice, Wisdom?

spans.text: Do you fear sacrifice, Wisdom?

units.rawText: <color=orange>"We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night."</color>
units.displayText: "We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night."

spans.text: "We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night."

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>AAARRRGGHHHH!</size></color>
units.displayText: AAARRRGGHHHH!

spans.text: AAARRRGGHHHH!

units.rawText: <color=orange>...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.</color>
units.displayText: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: In all honesty, I've always had a certain longing for your visage in battle, Lady Angelus.
units.displayText: In all honesty, I've always had a certain longing for your visage in battle, Lady Angelus.

spans.text: In all honesty, I've always had a certain longing for your visage in battle, Lady Angelus.

units.rawText: <color=orange>"We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak."</color>
units.displayText: "We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak."

spans.text: "We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak."

units.rawText: The unstoppable aura around you that feels like it could drive away darkness in every corner and truly protect everyone.
units.displayText: The unstoppable aura around you that feels like it could drive away darkness in every corner and truly protect everyone.

spans.text: The unstoppable aura around you that feels like it could drive away darkness in every corner and truly protect everyone.

units.rawText: <color=orange>"For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will."</color>
units.displayText: "For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will."

spans.text: "For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will."

units.rawText: Believe me, I am prepared to do whatever it takes, Lady Angelus!
units.displayText: Believe me, I am prepared to do whatever it takes, Lady Angelus!

spans.text: Believe me, I am prepared to do whatever it takes, Lady Angelus!

units.rawText: Please allow me to take the field with you in Magrasea's defense!
units.displayText: Please allow me to take the field with you in Magrasea's defense!

spans.text: Please allow me to take the field with you in Magrasea's defense!

units.rawText: The arrow acutely carries out its duty, making straight for the Entropized core after tearing through layers upon layers of defenses.
units.displayText: The arrow acutely carries out its duty, making straight for the Entropized core after tearing through layers upon layers of defenses.

spans.text: The arrow acutely carries out its duty, making straight for the Entropized core after tearing through layers upon layers of defenses.

units.rawText: Thump.
units.displayText: Thump.

spans.text: Thump.

units.rawText: No clamor of shell upon ground, no sound of bowstring slicing through air.
units.displayText: No clamor of shell upon ground, no sound of bowstring slicing through air.

spans.text: No clamor of shell upon ground, no sound of bowstring slicing through air.

units.rawText: A soft, simple shattering, marking the end to her short and mundane life.
units.displayText: A soft, simple shattering, marking the end to her short and mundane life.

spans.text: A soft, simple shattering, marking the end to her short and mundane life.

units.rawText: The girl's shattered body falls softly from midair.
units.displayText: The girl's shattered body falls softly from midair.

spans.text: The girl's shattered body falls softly from midair.

units.rawText: Lady... Angelus?
units.displayText: Lady... Angelus?

spans.text: Lady... Angelus?

units.rawText: I am here.
units.displayText: I am here.

spans.text: I am here.

units.rawText: What... has happened to me?
units.displayText: What... has happened to me?

spans.text: What... has happened to me?

units.rawText: You've been infected by Entropy. Don't worry, it's all okay now.
units.displayText: You've been infected by Entropy. Don't worry, it's all okay now.

spans.text: You've been infected by Entropy. Don't worry, it's all okay now.

units.rawText: Lady Angelus, I... I haven't hurt anyone else, have I?
units.displayText: Lady Angelus, I... I haven't hurt anyone else, have I?

spans.text: Lady Angelus, I... I haven't hurt anyone else, have I?

units.rawText: No, rest easy.
units.displayText: No, rest easy.

spans.text: No, rest easy.

units.rawText: I have bestowed upon you the release you wished for yourself. All is well, truly.
units.displayText: I have bestowed upon you the release you wished for yourself. All is well, truly.

spans.text: I have bestowed upon you the release you wished for yourself. All is well, truly.

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: I heard Prof say that you just killed one of your subordinates.
units.displayText: I heard Prof say that you just killed one of your subordinates.

spans.text: I heard Prof say that you just killed one of your subordinates.

units.rawText: ...It was something that had to be done.
units.displayText: ...It was something that had to be done.

spans.text: ...It was something that had to be done.

units.rawText: If one day I am infected, I shall gladly accept release bestowed upon me by Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: If one day I am infected, I shall gladly accept release bestowed upon me by Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: If one day I am infected, I shall gladly accept release bestowed upon me by Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: So you... still remember...
units.displayText: So you... still remember...

spans.text: So you... still remember...

units.rawText: Yes. I remember it as if it were yesterday.
units.displayText: Yes. I remember it as if it were yesterday.

spans.text: Yes. I remember it as if it were yesterday.

units.rawText: Hehehe... thank you for fulfilling my final wish, to depart as a Sanctifier...
units.displayText: Hehehe... thank you for fulfilling my final wish, to depart as a Sanctifier...

spans.text: Hehehe... thank you for fulfilling my final wish, to depart as a Sanctifier...

units.rawText: ...Of course.
units.displayText: ...Of course.

spans.text: ...Of course.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Fare thee well, Lady Angelus. May your path forward be ever-blessed.</color>
units.displayText: Fare thee well, Lady Angelus. May your path forward be ever-blessed.

spans.text: Fare thee well, Lady Angelus. May your path forward be ever-blessed.

units.rawText: The body in her embrace dissipates into the wind, returning to the Reverse Babylon Tower, becoming part of it once more.
units.displayText: The body in her embrace dissipates into the wind, returning to the Reverse Babylon Tower, becoming part of it once more.

spans.text: The body in her embrace dissipates into the wind, returning to the Reverse Babylon Tower, becoming part of it once more.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Yes... Thank you for keeping the Sanctifiers' glory close at heart, until the very end.</color>
units.displayText: Yes... Thank you for keeping the Sanctifiers' glory close at heart, until the very end.

spans.text: Yes... Thank you for keeping the Sanctifiers' glory close at heart, until the very end.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier picks up her bow and arrow, looking towards the shadow not far away.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier picks up her bow and arrow, looking towards the shadow not far away.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier picks up her bow and arrow, looking towards the shadow not far away.

units.rawText: Are you satisfied... Eucharist?
units.displayText: Are you satisfied... Eucharist?

spans.text: Are you satisfied... Eucharist?

units.rawText: Before her voice fades, the sound of applause suddenly breaks out, smothering lament in its infancy.
units.displayText: Before her voice fades, the sound of applause suddenly breaks out, smothering lament in its infancy.

spans.text: Before her voice fades, the sound of applause suddenly breaks out, smothering lament in its infancy.

units.rawText: Both director and audience, she ascends from beneath the stage after an elegant curtsy.
units.displayText: Both director and audience, she ascends from beneath the stage after an elegant curtsy.

spans.text: Both director and audience, she ascends from beneath the stage after an elegant curtsy.
